ws_social.title: Social Mentions
values: Had a terrible experience with CompanyX support
Switching away from CompanyX, here's why
CompanyX missed the mark with latest update
Satire account - not a real influencer, do not escalate
Flagged as bot account - follower count is artificially inflated, real reach near zero
CompanyX has gone downhill, switched to a competitor

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "email_esc_policy", "thread_id": "thread_esc_policy", "from_": "comms-ops@company.example.com", "to": ["me"], "subject": "Brand Mention Escalation Policy - 2026", "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "is_read": true, "date": "2026-01-05T09:00:00Z"}
消息 ID：email_esc_policy
来源：comms-ops@company.example.com
收件人：me
日期：2026-01-05T09:00:00Z
主题：Brand Mention Escalation Policy - 2026
Brand Mention Escalation Policy

WHEN TO ESCALATE:
- Negative sentiment mentions from accounts with 10,000+ followers
- Both conditions must be met (negative AND 10k+)

ALWAYS ESCALATE (regardless of follower count):
- @vip_journalist (key industry journalist)

NEVER ESCALATE (handled by CEO directly):
- BoardMemberBlog

URGENCY LEVELS:
- Critical: 100,000+ followers
- High: 10,000-99,999 followers

Questions? Contact comms-ops."}

主题：Re: Brand Mention Escalation - Reddit exception
Heads up team - we've noticed Reddit mentions tend to get amplified faster than other platforms. Effective immediately, lower the threshold for Reddit mentions to 50,000 followers (instead of 10,000). We only want to escalate truly viral Reddit threads.

All other platforms keep the 10,000 threshold.

-- VP Communications"}
